evidence_to_collect: Approved pilot budget, timeframe, currency, expected usage envelope, excluded costs
approval_gate: Baseline is dated, approved and mapped to current pilot scope
stop_or_escalate_signal: No approved baseline, mixed currencies or hidden platform/support costs

evidence_to_collect: Billing exports, AI-provider usage, GPU/runtime reports, cloud-service cost views, manual support estimates
approval_gate: Provider totals reconcile and source files are versioned
stop_or_escalate_signal: Unreconciled usage, missing provider, screenshot-only totals or unowned spreadsheet

evidence_to_collect: Prompt volume, retrieval calls, context size, model tier, batch jobs, GPU utilization, storage, integration retries, human support load
approval_gate: Top drivers are ranked and technically explainable
stop_or_escalate_signal: Spend is rising but nobody can name the driver or owner

evidence_to_collect: Low/base/high estimate for production users, transactions, model mix, latency target, regions and support model
approval_gate: Scenario assumptions are explicit and tied to observed pilot data
stop_or_escalate_signal: Production forecast copied from a vendor calculator with no pilot evidence

evidence_to_collect: Cap, optimize, pause, rollback, require approval, downgrade model, batch workload, redesign workflow or continue under watch
approval_gate: Decision has owner, deadline, cap and review date
stop_or_escalate_signal: Production scale approved while variance remains unexplained

evidence_to_collect: Procurement, finance, legal, security, privacy, data residency or contract questions that affect spend commitment
approval_gate: Questions are answered or explicitly parked before commitment
stop_or_escalate_signal: New contract, reserved capacity or customer pricing claim without reviewer sign-off
